_doc: Rows excused from tools/check/tolerance-diff.mjs: {file, line, reason}. `line` is a substring of the ADDED assertion line. A row that matches nothing in the diff is reported stale; delete it. Every row needs a reason a reviewer can read (AGENTS.md rule 9: never widen a tolerance to get green).

exceptions.reason: Not a tolerance: the pinned value is the top of the car surface-id range in the WGSL classifier. Garage finishes add ids 36 (tinted chrome), 37 (chameleon) and then 38 (forged carbon), 39 (gunmetal), 40 (gold plate) under FINISH_RESERVED, so the classifier bound moves 33 -> 37 -> 40 in GLX, TLX and WGX together; car-materials/livery-finish-contract tests pin the new ids. Finishes 60-85 (round 4 design lane, FINISH_RESERVED) branch as surfaceId == N in every backend, and surface-id-parity requires classifiedCar's bound to cover each branched id, so the top moves to 90.
